ai.title: AI Analyzer
ai.noProblems: No problems found. The code looks clean.
ai.noOneLineFix: Fix this by hand; there is no one-line change.
ai.waiting: Waiting for the student to fix these problems.
ai.sentNote: The fix list has been sent to the student.
ai.noFixedVersion: The student hasn’t uploaded a fixed version yet.
ai.studentResubmitted: The student uploaded a fixed version.
ai.consoleMsg: Debug logging was left in the code.
ai.consoleFix: Remove the console.log line, or use a proper logger.
ai.anyMsg: The type “any” turns off type checking.
ai.anyFix: Use a specific type, or “unknown” if the type really is not known.
ai.todoMsg: A TODO note was left in the code.
ai.todoFix: Finish the task and delete the comment.
ai.varMsg: “var” is outdated and leaks out of blocks.
ai.varFix: Use “const”, or “let” if the value changes.
ai.testMsg: The project has no test script.
ai.testFix: Add a “test” script to package.json and write at least one test.
ai.readmeFix: Add a README that explains what the project does and how to run it.
ai.allFixedNote: Every problem found earlier is now fixed.
ai.openNote: Ask the student to fix these and upload again.
ai.verified: The student’s new version was checked.
ai.taskFix: Redo this task, then upload the project again.
ai.allGood: No problems found and every task is correct.
ai.sentBack: Sent back to the student again (round {n}).
ai.waitingNew: Waiting for the student’s new upload.
ai.teacherVerifyHint: Everything checks out. Review the work yourself, then confirm.
